title: Chat System

functional: Deliver messages in real time and persist them for history.
Deliver messages to offline users and sync across multiple devices.
nonFunctional: Deliver messages under 200 ms at p95 within a region.
Preserve per-conversation order and never silently lose a message.
Tolerate reconnects and duplicate delivery without showing duplicates.
Scale to tens of millions of daily users and hundreds of millions of messages.
Degrade gracefully to push notifications when a device is offline.

checklist: Fan-out for groups and push notifications
Multi-region behavior, failure modes, and monitoring
followUps: How would you support end-to-end encryption without breaking search?
What changes if a group can have 100,000 members?
How would you migrate a conversation between storage shards without downtime?
How would you detect and handle a message that is stuck in the delivery pipeline?
commonMistakes: Ordering messages by server timestamp instead of a per-conversation sequence.
Acknowledging a send before the message is durably stored.
Fanning out a large group message synchronously inside the send request.
Treating presence as strongly consistent instead of a best-effort heartbeat.
Forgetting that a user can have several devices with independent cursors.
